829	// selectProviderIndex returns the provider list index to use for a backend pool
830	// given the strategy and a rotation counter.
831	//
832	// Supported strategies:
833	//   - "first-available" (default): always index 0
834	//   - "round-robin": counter % len(providers)
835	func selectProviderIndex(strategy string, counter, numProviders int) int {
836		if numProviders <= 0 {
837			return 0
838		}
839		if strategy == "round-robin" {
840			return counter % numProviders
841		}
842		// first-available and any unknown strategy
843		return 0
844	}

846	// ResolveBackend resolves a named backend pool to a concrete provider and model.
847	//
848	// counter is the rotation index used for round-robin selection; it should be
849	// the number of prior requests against this backend pool. Callers that want
850	// stateless first-available behavior can always pass 0.
851	//
852	// Concrete model selection is overrides.Model, then the backend model, then
853	// the provider's configured default model.
854	func (c *Config) ResolveBackend(name string, counter int, overrides ProviderOverrides) (agent.Provider, ProviderConfig, *modelcatalog.ResolvedTarget, error) {
855		bc, ok := c.Backends[name]
856		if !ok {
857			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: unknown backend pool %q", name)
858		}
859		if len(bc.Providers) == 0 {
860			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: backend pool %q has no providers", name)
861		}
862	
863		idx := selectProviderIndex(bc.Strategy, counter, len(bc.Providers))
864		providerName := bc.Providers[idx]
865	
866		effectiveOverrides := overrides
867		if effectiveOverrides.Model == "" && bc.Model != "" {
868			effectiveOverrides.Model = bc.Model
869		}
870	
871		p, pc, resolved, err := c.BuildProviderWithOverrides(providerName, effectiveOverrides)
872		if err != nil {
873			return nil, ProviderConfig{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("config: backend pool %q: %w", name, err)
874		}
875	
876		return p, pc, resolved, nil
877	}

445	// Resolve runs the engine end-to-end and returns a Decision.
446	//
447	// The engine:
448	//  1. Enumerates (harness, provider, model) candidates from inputs.
449	//  2. Applies gating (capability, override, model-pin, surface).
450	//  3. Scores per policy with cooldown demotion + perf bias.
451	//  4. Sorts viable → score → cost → locality → name.
452	//  5. Returns the top viable candidate with the full ranked list.
453	//
454	// Returns an error only when no viable candidate exists.
455	func Resolve(req Request, in Inputs) (*Decision, error) {
456		if in.Now.IsZero() {
457			in.Now = time.Now()
458		}
459		policyName, err := canonicalPolicy(req.Policy)
460		if err != nil {
461			return &Decision{}, err
462		}
463		req.Policy = policyName
464		if err := validateRequirements(req); err != nil {
465			return &Decision{}, err
466		}
467	
468		canonicalHarness := req.Harness
469		if canonicalHarness == "local" {
470			canonicalHarness = "fiz"
471		}
472		if err := explicitPinError(req, in); err != nil {
473			return &Decision{}, err
474		}
475	
476		var ranked []rankedCandidate
477		for _, h := range in.Harnesses {
478			// TestOnly harnesses (script/virtual) only reachable via explicit override.
479			if h.TestOnly && canonicalHarness != h.Name {
480				continue
481			}
482			// Automatic profile/tier routing is restricted to harnesses with full
483			// coverage. Explicit Harness pins can still use experimental/ad-hoc
484			// harnesses.
485			if canonicalHarness == "" && !h.AutoRoutingEligible {
486				continue
487			}
488			// Hard harness override: skip non-matching harnesses.
489			if canonicalHarness != "" && canonicalHarness != h.Name {
490				continue
491			}
492			entries := buildHarnessCandidates(h, req, in)
493			ranked = append(ranked, entries...)
494		}
495	
496		// Compute scores only after eligibility is final. Rejected candidates keep
497		// a zero score because cost/utilization/performance/sticky ranking should
498		// never influence the eligibility boundary.
499		for i := range ranked {
500			if !ranked[i].out.Eligible {
501				continue
502			}
503			ranked[i].out.Score = scorePolicy(req.Policy, ranked[i].internal)
504			ranked[i].out.ScoreComponents = scoreComponents(req.Policy, ranked[i].internal)
505			ranked[i].out.Reason = fmt.Sprintf("policy=%s; score=%.1f", req.Policy, ranked[i].out.Score)
506		}
507		neutralCost, hasKnownCost := neutralKnownCost(ranked)
508	
509		// Sort: eligible first, then descending score, then cost, then locality,
510		// then alphabetical.
511		sort.SliceStable(ranked, func(i, j int) bool {
512			ei, ej := ranked[i].out.Eligible, ranked[j].out.Eligible
513			if ei != ej {
514				return ei
515			}
516			if !ei {
517				return ranked[i].out.Harness < ranked[j].out.Harness
518			}
519			if ranked[i].out.Score != ranked[j].out.Score {
520				return ranked[i].out.Score > ranked[j].out.Score
521			}
522			if hasKnownCost {
523				ci := candidateCostTieValue(ranked[i], neutralCost)
524				cj := candidateCostTieValue(ranked[j], neutralCost)
525				if ci != cj {
526					return ci < cj
527				}
528			}
529			// Locality tiebreak: prefer local cost-class.
530			li := costClassRank[ranked[i].internal.CostClass] == 0
531			lj := costClassRank[ranked[j].internal.CostClass] == 0
532			if li != lj {
533				return li
534			}
535			if sameLocalEndpointGroup(ranked[i].internal, ranked[j].internal) {
536				if ranked[i].internal.EndpointSaturated != ranked[j].internal.EndpointSaturated {
537					return !ranked[i].internal.EndpointSaturated
538				}
539				if ranked[i].internal.EndpointLoad != ranked[j].internal.EndpointLoad {
540					return ranked[i].internal.EndpointLoad < ranked[j].internal.EndpointLoad
541				}
542			}
543			if ranked[i].out.Harness != ranked[j].out.Harness {
544				return ranked[i].out.Harness < ranked[j].out.Harness
545			}
546			return ranked[i].out.Provider < ranked[j].out.Provider
547		})
548	
549		out := make([]Candidate, len(ranked))
550		for i := range ranked {
551			out[i] = ranked[i].out
552		}
553	
554		for i := range out {
555			if out[i].Eligible {
556				return &Decision{
557					Harness:        out[i].Harness,
558					Provider:       out[i].Provider,
559					Endpoint:       out[i].Endpoint,
560					ServerInstance: out[i].ServerInstance,
561					Model:          out[i].Model,
562					Reason:         fmt.Sprintf("policy=%s; score=%.1f", req.Policy, out[i].Score),
563					Candidates:     out,
564				}, nil
565			}
566		}
567		if quotaErr := allProvidersQuotaExhaustedError(ranked); quotaErr != nil {
568			return &Decision{Candidates: out}, quotaErr
569		}
570		if requested := requestedModelIntent(req); requested != "" && req.Provider == "" && canonicalHarness == "" && hasLiveDiscoveryCandidates(ranked) {
571			return &Decision{Candidates: out}, fmt.Errorf("no live endpoint offers a match for %s", requested)
572		}
573		if missingRequirement := missingPolicyRequirement(req, out); missingRequirement != "" {
574			return &Decision{Candidates: out}, &ErrPolicyRequirementUnsatisfied{
575				Policy:      req.Policy,
576				Requirement: missingRequirement,
577				Rejected:    len(out),
578			}
579		}
580		return &Decision{Candidates: out}, noViableCandidateError(req, len(out))
581	}

583	// allProvidersQuotaExhaustedError returns ErrAllProvidersQuotaExhausted when
584	// at least one routing candidate was rejected solely because its provider is
585	// in the quota_exhausted state and no other candidate was eligible. The set
586	// of otherwise-eligible candidates collapses to those flagged with
587	// quotaExhaustedRetryAfter (the engine sets this only when the candidate
588	// passed every other gate). When that set is empty the existing
589	// no-viable / no-profile-candidate / live-discovery errors describe the
590	// failure more precisely.
591	func allProvidersQuotaExhaustedError(ranked []rankedCandidate) error {
592		var exhausted []string
593		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
594		var earliest time.Time
595		for _, c := range ranked {
596			if c.quotaExhaustedRetryAfter.IsZero() {
597				continue
598			}
599			name := c.out.Provider
600			if name == "" {
601				name = c.out.Harness
602			}
603			if _, dup := seen[name]; !dup {
604				seen[name] = struct{}{}
605				exhausted = append(exhausted, name)
606			}
607			if earliest.IsZero() || c.quotaExhaustedRetryAfter.Before(earliest) {
608				earliest = c.quotaExhaustedRetryAfter
609			}
610		}
611		if len(exhausted) == 0 {
612			return nil
613		}
614		return &ErrAllProvidersQuotaExhausted{
615			RetryAfter:         earliest,
616			ExhaustedProviders: exhausted,
617		}
618	}
